description: A Flutter widget implementing a TV-friendly on-screen keyboard with DPAD navigation, designed for use in fullscreen/modal routes. It manages focus and key navigation explicitly to provide a predictable experience for remote control navigation on TV devices. The widget maintains an internal buffer, provides callbacks for buffer changes, submission, and cancellation, and renders a grid of character keys and action buttons.

classes.name: OnScreenKeyboard
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a customizable on-screen keyboard suitable for TV navigation, providing a static method to show it modally and manage user input.

classes.name: _OnScreenKeyboardState
classes.description: State object managing the keyboard's internal buffer, focus traversal, key handling, and UI rendering.

classes.name: _KeySpec
classes.description: A class representing individual keys or action buttons on the keyboard layout.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to present the keyboard dialog and return the submitted string or null if canceled.

methods.name: _buildKeys
methods.description: Constructs the list of keys and action buttons arranged in a grid layout.

methods.name: _notifyChanged
methods.description: Calls the onChanged callback if provided, with the current buffer.

methods.name: _append
methods.description: Appends a character to the internal buffer.

methods.name: _backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from the buffer.

methods.name: _space
methods.description: Inserts a space into the buffer.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Calls the onSubmitted callback with the current buffer.

methods.name: _cancel
methods.description: Calls the onCancelled callback to dismiss the keyboard.

methods.name: _handleBack
methods.description: Handles back or escape key presses to dismiss the dialog.

methods.name: _previewText
methods.description: Returns the current buffer text, obscured if required.

methods.name: _handleKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles DPAD and selection keys for navigation and activation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including the grid of keys and the input display, with focus management and styling.

methods.name: _activateKey
methods.description: Performs actions related to the activated key (character input or action).
